ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 20-25% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage concentrated on distal lobes and scattered along the lower margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke areas consist of contiguous low-intensity black pixels. High-contrast white mottling is localized at the lateral distal tips of both lobes, featuring irregular geometric boundaries. Fine white pixel stippling is visible along the lower left and right margins near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible trailing edge. Multiple distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in depth relative to the primary contour line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex arcs sweeping upward and outward, terminating in sharply tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast grey/white pixel groupings (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme outer tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct diagonal linear pixel disruption (white rake mark) located on the inner-mid region of the right lobe, oriented toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; secondary localized white scarring on the left lobe surface near the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, small circular white focal spot located on the right lobe, approximately 15% distance from the median notch toward the distal tip.
